title: React
paragraph:
Developed component-based interfaces with React, using reusable logic through hooks and context.

Set up dynamic routing with React Router, including role-based NotFound pages and protected routes.

Built and connected forms (auth, filters, search) with controlled inputs and validation, integrating API calls via fetch/axios etc

title: TypeScript
paragraph:
Used TypeScript to enforce strict typing and improve code readability in all components and API logic.

Integrated TypeScript with external libraries (e.g., Ant Design, React Router) to ensure safe component props and data flow etc

title: HTML
paragraph:
Built accessible and semantic HTML structures following best practices and SEO principles.

Worked with forms, tables, and multimedia content to create well-structured layouts across projects etc

title: Ant Design
paragraph:
Built responsive interfaces using Ant Design components with consistent layout and theming.

Customized elements like tables, forms, modals, and tooltips to match app logic and UX needs.
Integrated Ant Design with TypeScript and React context for type-safe, dynamic behavior across views etc

title: Java Script
paragraph:
Built interactive user interfaces using modern JavaScript (ES6+) features such as destructuring, optional chaining, and arrow functions.

Worked with fetch and async/await to connect with REST APIs, handle errors, and process responses.

Implemented reusable utility functions for filtering, sorting, validating inputs, and managing application state.

Created interactive forms with validation, conditional rendering etc

title: Sass/less
paragraph:
Built flexible, scalable styles using variables, mixins and nesting.

Implemented responsive design with media queries and dynamic theming (light/dark modes) etc

title: CSS
paragraph:
Crafted clean, responsive layouts using Flexbox and Grid to ensure smooth experiences across devices.

Paid special attention to visual clarity, accessibility, and cohesive styling throughout the interface etc

title: Strapi
paragraph:
Integrated Strapi services with React front-end to deliver dynamic, content-driven pages.

Consumed REST/GraphQL endpoints, handled authentication tokens, and rendered localized content and media.
